name: Судья
notes: The Judge: the undefeated second stage of Kragmir's big arena. A living adult magma dragon, caged for generations in a cavern beneath the arena floor, raised on chains when a qualified team is proud or desperate enough to declare the Mountain's Trial. Nobody has ever won; the prize pool has been accumulating for decades. His hoard is not gold but the weapons and armor of every champion he has killed. He is ancient, intelligent, and speaks old Dwarven when he bothers to speak at all; he greets Bradgar by name, remembers every team the Anvil ever led down, and watched the party's qualifying bout through the floor grates. A century of mythras-laced ore has made his scale glass-hard and his fire is beginning to stutter with the mountain's decay: the first crack anyone has ever seen in him. Beaten low enough, he can do the one thing no living dwarf has heard: yield.

actions.name: Pyroclastic Breath
actions.text: The dragon breathes a blast of magma that deals @Damage[7d6[fire],4d12[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] in a @Template[type:cone|distance:40] (@Check[type:reflex|dc:33|basic:true|options:area-effect]). He can't use Pyroclastic Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Pyroclastic Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.

actions.name: Volcanic Purge
actions.text:
If the next action the dragon uses is Pyroclastic Breath, the magma clings to those it damages. Each creature that fails its save against Pyroclastic Breath takes @Damage[4d6[persistent,fire]] damage, and as long as it has this persistent fire damage, it also takes a -10-foot status penalty to its Speeds.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.Effect: Volcanic Purge]

actions.name: Draconic Frenzy
actions.text: The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one horn Strike in any order.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.text:
The dragon takes on the appearance of a Medium humanoid. This does not change their Speed or their attack and damage bonuses with their Strikes but might change the damage type their Strikes deal (typically to bludgeoning).

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

actions.name: Wing Deflection
actions.text:
Trigger The dragon is targeted with an attack.

Effect The dragon raises a wing, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the dragon is Flying, he descends 10 feet after the attack.

actions.name: Draconic Momentum
actions.text: The dragon recharges his Pyroclastic Breath whenever he scores a critical hit with a Strike.

actions.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic
actions.text: The Судья gains a +1 status bonus to all saving throws against magic.

actions.name: Magma Burrow
actions.text: The Судья's burrow Speed functions only when he is Burrowing through magma or molten lava.

actions.name: Judge's Scale
actions.text: A century of mythras-laced ore turned his scale glass-hard: the Судья has resistance 10 to physical damage. Adamantine weapons, including the arena's old ballista bolts, bypass this resistance, and it is suspended entirely while his Old Wound is torn open.

actions.name: The Old Wound
actions.text: An adamantine bolt head from Брадгар's greatest attempt sits beneath the scale of the Судья's left wing joint, and the wound has never closed clean. While the Судья is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone] or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Restrained], a creature can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Mount] him with a successful DC 33 Athletics or Acrobatics check. A creature mounted on him can spend 2 actions to drive the bolt deeper with a DC 33 Athletics check: on a success, the Судья takes @Damage[4d10[piercing]] damage and the wound tears open: apply @UUID[Compendium.the-shards-forge.shards-abilities.Item.shardssudyawnd00]{Effect: Open Wound} to him.

actions.name: Faltering Flame
actions.text: The mythras in his fire is failing with the mountain's. While the Судья has 90 Hit Points or fewer, Pyroclastic Breath no longer takes 1d4 rounds to recharge, but each use deals @Damage[4d6[fire]] damage to the Судья himself as the flame misfires inside him. This damage ignores his fire immunity: it is his own blood burning wrong.
